note: PLACEHOLDER, NOT A PILOT LIST. Every host below is an IANA-reserved documentation domain (RFC 2606 / RFC 6761), chosen precisely because none of them is a real third party whose terms of service anyone has read. This file exists so the loader, the digest and the path-scope matcher have a shipped artifact to be tested against; it is not a statement that any destination has been cleared for traffic. A real list is a governance decision, it names no authentication endpoint, and it does not land here. Design authority: the 'Residential Proxy Network - Worker & Tunnel Spec (Tasks 18-36, 44, 45, 47)', Task 29.
